name: Soho Giyim Ve Enerji Anonim Sirketi
summary: Soho Giyim Ve Enerji Anonim Sirketi engages in manufacturing, importing, and exporting men apparel and accessories. It offers ready-to-wear clothing products, such as t-shirts, shirts, coats, jackets, swimwear, underwear, suits, blazers, footwear, shorts, trousers, sweatpants, belt, scarves, hats, umbrella, and bags. The company also operates solar power plants to generate electricity. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
